condition.narrative: Should contribute directly to results for children as outlined in the UNDAF, national results and/or UNICEF Strategic Plan and within the scope defined in the CPD, CPAP, OMP or other agreed upon programme documents

title.narrative: UNICEF prioritized evidence-based policy dialogue on climate-smart education strategies, data-driven decision-making, education decentralization, and lifelong learning, engaging over 3,000 stakeholders across forums, workshops, and conferences. Key initiatives focused on equity in school funding, cross-border humanitarian response, and climate-smart education and data analyses to inform pro-equity policies and resilient education systems.
